      com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model.LatencyMatrix.average(MetroId)
      Internal; scheduled for deletion, not part of the supported API. The Double.MAX_VALUE sentinel reads as a real measurement. Use LatencyMatrix.averageMs(MetroId), which makes the absent case explicit.
      com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model.LatencyMatrix.worstCase(MetroId)
      Internal; scheduled for deletion, not part of the supported API. The Double.MAX_VALUE sentinel reads as a real measurement and has been formatted into user-facing text as such. Use LatencyMatrix.worstCaseMs(MetroId), which makes the absent case explicit.
